touch.definition: CREATE TRIGGER touch AFTER INSERT ON orders EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch()
CREATE TRIGGER touch AFTER INSERT ON foreign_orders EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.touch()
CREATE TRIGGER touch AFTER INSERT ON same_orders EXECUTE FUNCTION public.same()
CREATE TRIGGER touch AFTER INSERT ON audit_orders EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.same()

touch().definition: CREATE FUNCTION touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; RETURN NEW; END; $$

public.same().definition: CREATE FUNCTION public.same() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; RETURN NEW; END; $$

audit.same().definition: CREATE FUNCTION audit.same() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE audit_accounts SET value = 1; RETURN NEW; END; $$
